abstract: Autoimmune encephalitis frequently presents with prominent psychiatric symptoms and may mimic primary psychiatric disorders, particularly in the early stages. We report the case of a 38-year-old man who presented with a 2-week history of behavioral disturbance, persecutory ideation, auditory hallucinations, and fluctuating disorganization of thought and behavior, without prior psychiatric history. During hospitalization, the clinical picture evolved to include psychomotor retardation and prominent catatonic features. Given the subacute onset and atypical presentation, autoimmune encephalitis was suspected. Cancer screening identified a mixed testicular germ cell tumor, and right orchiectomy was performed. Despite tumor removal and immunotherapy, the patient showed no meaningful clinical improvement and progressed to severe catatonia. Pharmacological treatment with benzodiazepines and antipsychotic medications was ineffective. Electroconvulsive therapy was therefore initiated. After 12 bitemporal electroconvulsive therapy sessions, a marked and sustained clinical improvement was observed, with progressive resolution of catatonic, psychotic, and behavioral symptoms. This case highlights that severe catatonia may represent the dominant psychiatric manifestation of seronegative paraneoplastic encephalitis and suggests that electroconvulsive therapy may be an effective therapeutic option for refractory catatonia in this context.
abstract_ja: 自己免疫性脳炎は精神症状を前景に呈することが多く、特に初期には原発性精神疾患と誤認されやすい。38歳男性が、2週間の行動異常、被害妄想、幻聴、思考と行動の変動する混乱を呈した。精神病歴はない。入院中に精神運動抑制と顕著な緊張病の特徴が加わった。亜急性の発症と非定型的な臨床像から、自己免疫性脳炎が疑われた。がん検索で混合型精巣胚細胞腫瘍が見つかり、右精巣摘除術が施行された。腫瘍切除と免疫療法を行ったが臨床的な改善は得られず、重度の緊張病へ進行した。ベンゾジアゼピン系薬剤と抗精神病薬による薬物療法は無効であった。そこで電気けいれん療法を開始した。両側性の電気けいれん療法を12回施行後、緊張病、精神病症状、行動症状の持続的で顕著な改善が認められ、症状は徐々に消失した。本症例は、重度の緊張病が血清陰性の腫瘍随伴性脳炎の主要な精神症状となりうること、また電気けいれん療法が難治性緊張病に対する有効な治療選択肢となりうることを示している。
